translations.web: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
translations.bsb: So they brought it, and He asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.
translations.kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
